Name: Throwable Weeds
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
Ever felt like the game didn't appreciate the one true weeds™ enough? Why are all the other weeds out there being on your farm and annoying you and no weedses to be found? Well!

With this mood you finally get a chance to  get your hands on weeds™ again! And not just that but you can throw them at your enemies! Watch as the weedses bounce around the map and hit your enemies while you cackle in joy.

Get your weeds today![/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=1]Happy birthday to the biggest fool, me!
[/size]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher. 
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.
